sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

I am writing to follow up on our last offer of €50.10 per unit, as we have not yet heard back from you. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

For our family-run foundry, maintaining the high quality of our craftsmanship and honoring our shared regional ties remain central to how we do business. Our current proposal stands at a price of €50.10 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Please let us know your decision so we can secure the necessary production capacity for your order. We value our long-standing partnership and look forward to your reply.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our long relationship and understand that rising wage and metal costs put pressure on your family-run foundry and skilled team. Our full demand for this part is committed to you, and a long contract term offers planning security. Would that framework help you reconsider the increase?

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file (cost:part:PH-100).
Your letter (doc:D01-LETTER) gives less notice than our agreement provides for (ctr:D01-FRAMEWORK).
We compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342).

On this basis we propose: EUR 48.88 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01, for our full demand of 4000 units a year over 24 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We value our long-standing relationship and are pleased to accept your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms.
To respect the notice period you cited, we have adjusted the effective date to 1 February 2027 as a trade for these extended terms.
Under this framework, we propose a revised unit price of €50.40.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 February 2027: €50.40 per unit.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for taking our cited data into account and for moving your offer; we appreciate both and value our long-standing relationship. We understand that costs are moving, and hope the planning security of a long contract term, together with our fixed order volume—all our demand for this part over the term—helps support a stable arrangement. Our proposal moves toward you again, and we hope it provides a constructive basis for agreement.

We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 49.41 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-02-01, for our full demand of 4000 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
